# Corner Store Dash — full reference

Last updated: 2026-10-06
Play / canonical URL: https://ebt-corner-store-dash.prodbykctw.workers.dev/

## TL;DR

Corner Store Dash is a free browser game from the EBT (Everything But Trapped) brand. It comes in two parts: a 70-second drive down Auburn Ave to the corner store, then a run through the store to grab everything on the EBT list before the bully catches you. Plays on phone or desktop, no download, no sign-up. Scores go on a global leaderboard.

Developer: PRODBYKCTW LLC (Melvin D. Brown III, @prodbyKCTW) / RARƎ AGENCY. Genre: arcade / driving / chase. Platform: web browser (phone and desktop). Price: free.

## What it is

A standalone game presented by EBT (Everything But Trapped), the Atlanta brand run by Kema. You drive to the EBT corner store on Auburn Ave in Atlanta, park out front, and go inside, where you race to collect every item on the EBT list, dodge the bully and pay at a register.

## How to play

### 1. The drive (70 seconds)

- Get to the corner store before the clock runs out and park in the spot out front.
- Don't hit the police: hit a police car and you're BUSTED (drive again).
- Grab EBT tokens on the way.
- Bonus (carried into the store run): 50 per second left on the clock, 25 per EBT token, 50 per near miss, +500 for a clean park, +300 for a drive with no hits.
- Run out of time and you walk the rest of the way in (no bonus).
- Touch controls: ◀ ▶ change lanes, one lane per tap; GAS to go; BRAKE to stop (hold to reverse); HORN clears the way.
- Keyboard: arrows or WASD, SPACE = horn, P = pause.

### 2. The store

- Grab all 7 items on the EBT list: apple, chips, chicken, lemonade, bread, milk, rice & beans.
- Don't get caught by the bully. You get one continue per run, and you keep the items you already have.
- With the list complete, pay at any register (the PAY spots in front of the counters) to win.
- Touch controls: drag anywhere on the screen to move. Keyboard: arrows or WASD, P = pause.
- Scoring: 100 per item (200 for rice & beans), 500 for checking out, a speed bonus of up to 1,500 (a faster run scores more), plus the drive bonus.
- After a run, enter three initials and save your score to the global leaderboard.

## Tech

The drive is a 3D level built with three.js on OpenStreetMap map data of Auburn Ave; the store is an HTML5 canvas game. Both run in the browser. The game and its leaderboard are served by a Cloudflare Worker with a D1 database.
